solutions.title: Length count and split
solutions.strategy: Count length and remember the tail, find the node before the rotated suffix, split there, and attach the old tail to the old head.

timeComplexity.explanation: One scan counts nodes and a second bounded walk finds the split point, so total work is linear.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and a few pointers are stored while original nodes are relinked.

solutions.title: Circular list then break
solutions.strategy: Compute length and tail, temporarily connect tail to head, then break the circle at the new tail.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm scans once to find length and tail, then walks to the new tail.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a few pointers and counters are stored while the original nodes are reused.
